name: True North Sauna 6-8 Person 9' Long Barrel Sauna
description: Description This beautiful barrel sauna is handmade in Ontario, Canada. It has been developed for outdoor use in nature and can withstand any weather. It is 9 ' long and has an inside standing height of 6' . You can select an optional 2' porch (which decreases inside length). Different window options are available and you can choose if you want a wood stove or an electric heater inside. The sauna comes as a kit that requires assembly . Features: 2 wood options: White Cedar- slightly stronger and almost as resistant to rot and decay as red cedar, and has a beautiful light-colored finish. Red Cedar- naturally weather and insect-resistant, gives off a pleasant and recognizable scent and is aesthetically attractive. Comes standard with roof membrane & 2nd layer of roof boards Fascia boards to protect the end grain of the barrel wood 2 premium benches for sitting and reclining Partially pre-assembled construction with built-in venting holes Mounts on 4 wooden cradles Also Includes: 3 peg towel hanger, Vent kit and cover, Screws for assembly, Flat floor , Door handles, Glass door, Benches Optional front and rear windows Optional 2' wide porch which decreases inside space accordingly. Total length remains the same. Specifications Specs: Seats: 6-8 people Interior Volume: 280 cu.ft. or 218 cu.ft. w/ porch Overall Size: Length 108”L x 89.25”W x 90.5"H Cradle Size: 52” L x 3” W x 7.5” H Bench Length: 101 ½” no porch 77 ½” with 2’ porch Wood: White Cedar or Red Cedar Walls: 1.55" thick solid wood Door: Wood-framed glass Made in: Canada Assembly Assembly Guide
